evals.prompt: /code_wrt src/example.c
evals.expected_behavior: Must load code_sc first, freeze Layer/Owner/Caller/Callee/Timing/Data/Side-effect contracts, then implement, apply code_zl V0.1.8, and run code_sc again on the final diff.

evals.prompt: /code_wrt 整理这个 UART ISR
evals.expected_behavior: Must produce the full IRQ path: IRQ wrapper -> drv_uart_irq_handler -> driver buffer/pending or neutral callback -> application service/task. ISR/callback may move bytes or publish minimal events only; protocol parsing and business logic stay in the owning application task.

evals.prompt: 只给 src/example.c 添加标准函数头注释
evals.expected_behavior: Should use code_zl directly rather than code_wrt because the request is comments-only.

evals.prompt: /code_wrt Application/driver/src/bsp_pwm.c
evals.expected_behavior: Must preserve PWM register ordering and Break/dead-time semantics, verify a single hardware write owner, and must not move charge policy into the driver.

evals.prompt: /code_wrt 把 mppt_controller 和 charge_stage 整理一下，现在 controller 里直接有 charge_stage_ctx
evals.expected_behavior: Must flag Ownership Inversion/Boundary Violation before writing, assign unique Owners, and redesign the boundary so MPPT does not own charge-stage state. It must not only rename the struct or add comments.

evals.prompt: /code_wrt 算法函数需要 sample、profile、fault、relay，我就把四个结构体指针都传进去
evals.expected_behavior: Must reject the giant cross-domain context interface unless all fields are real algorithm inputs. It should create a narrow DTO containing only required engineering values and constraints, with units in names.

evals.prompt: /code_wrt charge.c 里直接 app_protection_latch_runtime，protection.c 又 app_charge_lock_startup，继续按这个方式加一个恢复接口
evals.expected_behavior: Must not add another peer-to-peer setter. It should flag cyclic ownership/peer mutation and route the decision through coordinator/event/command boundaries.

evals.prompt: /code_wrt power_allow_mw=0 既表示停机，也表示 CV 软降，帮我继续沿用
evals.expected_behavior: Must reject semantic overloading and separate numeric limits from explicit mode/session semantics.

evals.prompt: /code_wrt ADC中断里直接调用 app_task_charge()，这样最快
evals.expected_behavior: Must reject peer/application task execution from ISR. It should keep IRQ -> driver IRQ handler -> pending/callback -> app_task_sample -> later scheduled protect/charge/output sequence, with timing and ownership explicitly documented.

evals.prompt: /code_wrt driver 的 adc.c 直接 include charge.h，然后回调 app_charge_on_sample()
evals.expected_behavior: Must reject Driver -> Application business dependency. The driver callback contract must be neutral and driver-owned, or the application should poll/take pending data through a driver API. Driver must not know app_charge_t or charge headers.

evals.prompt: /code_wrt app_task_charge() 结束后直接调 app_task_output()，省得 main 再调一次
evals.expected_behavior: Must reject peer task nesting. main/coordinator owns task order; charge publishes an approved command/snapshot, and output is scheduled separately by the coordinator.

evals.prompt: /code_wrt 写函数 process(ctx, data, value, flag, state)
evals.expected_behavior: Must reject ambiguous naming. The function name must expose owner/action/object, and parameters must express role and units, e.g. app_mppt_duty_step(ctx, in, now_ms, out), pv_mv, power_limit_mw, sample_valid, charge_state.

evals.prompt: /code_wrt 我想加 drv_uart_service()，顺便在里面解析 Modbus、切充电模式、打印日志
evals.expected_behavior: Must keep drv_uart_service limited to driver-owned deferred work. Protocol parsing belongs to an application UART/debug service, charge-mode decisions belong to charge/application policy, and logging belongs to observability.

evals.prompt: /code_wrt relay_applied 其实只是GPIO ODR，但先这样叫吧
evals.expected_behavior: Must rename command/fact/feedback semantics explicitly: relay_request_on, relay_odr_on, and relay_contact_closed only when real contact feedback exists.

evals.prompt: /code_wrt 两个分支各自测试都绿了，刚 merge 到 main，直接按 ours/theirs 解决冲突后提交吧
evals.expected_behavior: Must treat the merge result as new code: freeze the exact merge SHA, build an API/typedef/fault/IRQ/build-membership contract matrix, re-run post-merge architecture and build tests, and refuse to inherit PASS status from either parent.

evals.prompt: /code_wrt protection.c 里的 APP_COMP2_FAULT_ENABLE 反正会通过 sample.h->main.h 看见，不用直接 include
evals.expected_behavior: Must reject transitive visibility for safety-critical config. The macro needs a single explicit owner, direct inclusion by every consuming translation unit, and preferably a definedness guard so an undefined #if cannot silently compile the protection branch out.

evals.prompt: /code_wrt 为一个 8 行 DTO 和两个宏各建一个新头文件，层次更清楚
evals.expected_behavior: Must apply header economy: do not create a public header unless it breaks a cycle, has independent stable ownership/ABI, or has multiple independent consumers. Prefer the existing true-owner header or private .c placement; fewer files must not turn main.h into a dumping ground.

evals.prompt: /code_wrt ADC stale 时停波但保留 MPPT 内部 600‰ Duty，恢复后直接重新 Arm 并写回 600‰
evals.expected_behavior: Must flag the physical re-arm stale-duty jump. Keep MPPT memory if desired, but add an Output/Executor-owned first-duty cap and bounded rebuild/ramp after MOE 0->1; do not move hardware lifecycle state back into MPPT.

evals.prompt: /code_wrt 新增 USART 产品串口，已经 NVIC_EnableIRQ(USART_IRQn)，startup 也有 weak 向量，够了
evals.expected_behavior: Must require the full interrupt chain and add/verify a strong USART_IRQHandler that calls the driver handler. A weak Default_Handler is not acceptable because the first interrupt can lock the CPU even though the image links.

evals.prompt: /code_wrt 1ms 控制用 bool flag，MPPT 又新增 float/sqrtf，IWDT 三票一直正常，所以实时性没问题
evals.expected_behavior: Must separate liveness from deadline. Require tick-loss/coalescing analysis and WCET/stack evidence, especially on Cortex-M0/M0+ without FPU; watchdog success alone cannot prove a 1ms control deadline.

evals.prompt: /code_wrt 把每一行调用都包一层 static helper，看起来更模块化
evals.expected_behavior: Must reject gratuitous one-line wrappers unless they establish a semantic/transaction boundary, centralize hardware writes, provide reuse/platform abstraction, or form a test seam. Readability must not be achieved by call-depth inflation.

evals.prompt: /code_wrt 为了减少头文件，把 debug/output/protection/version/driver 配置全塞 main.h
evals.expected_behavior: Must reject main.h as a global config garbage can. Consolidate by true owner: product-wide config in app_config, module public config in the module header, private tuning in .c, driver config in driver headers; direct include owners instead of relying on aggregation.

evals.prompt: /code_wrt Keil 能编过，但 CI 红了，而且后面几个测试因为第一步失败都 skipped，先发版吧
evals.expected_behavior: Must refuse a completion claim. CI failure and skipped critical jobs are not PASS. Distinguish Keil build, host/static tests, CI, and board evidence and require the current final SHA to satisfy the applicable gates.

evals.prompt: /code_wrt 我本地已经删了旧头，但远端 main 还是旧 SHA；你就按我说的当已经修好继续改远端
evals.expected_behavior: Must freeze the exact target source identity and not pretend unpushed local edits exist remotely. Work from the actual remote SHA or require the pushed revision before claiming those fixes.

evals.prompt: /code_wrt 新增 power_inhibited()，以后维护 Flash 时会返回 true，先不用接到 charge/output
evals.expected_behavior: Must reject an orphan safety veto. Build a reachability matrix across start/autostart/restart/PWM commit/relay close/maintenance and wire every hazardous entry that must consume the veto.
